title: coffea arabica var. mauritiana
intro: Coffea arabica var. mauritiana, commonly known as Mauritius coffee, is a variety of the Arabica coffee plant native to the island of Mauritius. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Coffea arabica var. mauritiana include stimulation of the central nervous system, improvement of mood, and enhancement of cognitive function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids such as caffeine and theobromine, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
